contentPattern.structure: tab labels + one rich-content panel per tab (paragraphs, images, lists, sub-headings)

suitableFor: generic tabbed content panels holding arbitrary rich content (paragraphs, images, lists, headings)
adventure/product detail Overview / Itinerary / What-to-Bring style tabs
any 'switch between long-form sections' UI where each panel is free-form editorial content
notSuitableFor: category-filtered card grids driven by a tab bar (use tabs-adventures)
